name: B10-0465/2025 (PPE) – Polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the polarisation and increased repression in Serbia, one year after the Novi Sad tragedy
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking Serbia to do several things: investigate the Novi Sad station roof collapse that killed 16 people, stop excessive force against peaceful protesters, protect free speech and civil society, and align its foreign policy with the EU's. It also repeats that Serbia's path to EU membership depends on meeting democratic standards.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is Parliament's demand, not a new law.
- **Who it affects:** Serbia's government, courts, police, protesters and civil society.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions and Serbian authorities; no deadline is set.
